races.name: Driftborn Human
races.tagline: Stubborn rim-stock who built Siltport out of rusted hulls and grit.
races.description: Raised between pressurized tin towns and sputtering ley-tugs, Driftborn carry no natural arcana—only an instinct for rallying desperate crews when the air runs thin.
races.hiddenHint: Outpost settlers tend to recognize one of their own.

races.name: Aether-Elf
races.tagline: Long-lived starfarers whose marrow still remembers the Pre-Collapse lattice.
races.description: Silver-irised and slender, Aether-Elves hear harmonic drift long before ship sensors register it. Many Syndicate overseers fear what they might wake in the deep reef.
races.hiddenHint: Ley-glass and ancient obelisks hum a little louder in your palm.

races.name: Ironkin Dwarf
races.tagline: Vault-forged engineers who trust riveted steel over whispered magic.
races.description: Broad-chested and soot-handed, Ironkin clans kept the outer drydocks spinning after the Collapse. They treat erratic spells as a wiring fault waiting for a wrench.
races.hiddenHint: Grounded copper and honest torque never lied to anyone.

races.name: Vexari
races.tagline: Void-adapted reptilian scouts with heat-sensing scales and quiet boots.
races.description: Evolved in dim asteroid warrens, Vexari read thermal leaks and patrol blindspots like an open ledger. They prefer slipping past a ward-net to kicking it down.
races.hiddenHint: Even shipboard sensors seem reluctant to pin down your silhouette.

races.name: Ironforged
races.tagline: Decommissioned rune-chassis mercenaries carrying a furnace where a heart should be.
races.description: Built during the Tariff Wars and later cast off to scrap, Ironforged pilots endure hull-shocks and plasma recoil that would pulping flesh-and-bone crews.
races.hiddenHint: Syndicate deckhands still flinch at the whine of your servo-joints.

backgrounds.name: Syndicate Defector
backgrounds.tagline: You walked off a Ledger-Cutter with a stolen transponder and a price on your name.
backgrounds.description: Years of enforcing customs blockades taught you every bribe, back-channel cipher, and blind spot in the Inner Drift.
backgrounds.flavorHook: You know how Syndicate captains think—and when they're bluffing.

backgrounds.name: Ley-Archive Scholar
backgrounds.tagline: Disgraced from the Core Academies for reading forbidden Pre-Collapse charts.
backgrounds.description: You spent a decade translating dead star-script and harmonic tables before funding dried up and the Syndicate sealed your archive.
backgrounds.flavorHook: Dead relays and basalt obelisks aren't gibberish to you.

backgrounds.name: Rim Mercenary
backgrounds.tagline: Hired gun for convoy escorts until your last contractor stiffed the crew.
backgrounds.description: You've traded plasma fire in zero-g corridors and walked away from three hull breaches with your boots still magnetized.
backgrounds.flavorHook: When negotiations sour, you're already reaching for the carbine.

backgrounds.name: Wreck-Salvager
backgrounds.tagline: Born with a plasma torch in one hand and a dead ship's schematic in the other.
backgrounds.description: You've stripped half a dozen drifting hulks before Syndicate cutters arrived, coaxing dead reactors back to life on copper wire.
backgrounds.flavorHook: No bulkhead stays sealed once you find its junction box.

backgrounds.name: Freebooter Envoy
backgrounds.tagline: Smooth-talking broker between cantina syndicates and desperate outpost mayors.
backgrounds.description: You've talked trigger-happy captains down from airlock spacing with nothing but a warm grin and well-timed debt.
backgrounds.flavorHook: Every dockmaster on the rim owes someone—you just figure out who.
